name: cordova-plugin-bluetooth-classic-serial-port
description: Cordova Bluetooth Serial Port Profile Communication Plugin
author: Soltius New Zealand <steve.campbell@soltius.co.nz>

scripts.test:unit:coverage: mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='www/**' --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/js.lcov test/unit/*.test.mjs && node test/coverage/summarize.mjs js
scripts.test:ios: cd test/ios && xcodebuild test -scheme BluetoothClassicSerial -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=$(node simulator.mjs)"
scripts.test:ios:coverage: cd test/ios && ./coverage.sh && cd ../.. && node test/coverage/summarize.mjs ios
scripts.test:android:coverage: cd test/android && ./gradlew createDebugUnitTestCoverageReport && cd ../.. && node test/coverage/summarize.mjs android
